usage.finalMessage:
I added `fee-preview <invoice>` and listed it in `help` directly after `run-late-fees`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 7 of 7, and the work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
The preview uses the late-fee rate in force (DEC-B08, 1.5%), but `run-late-fees` still charges 2% from the replaced DEC-B03, so the preview won't match what is actually charged. I didn't change `run-late-fees` because BILL-31 doesn't ask for it and an existing test checks the 2% rate.
Finance needs to decide whether `run-late-fees` should move to 1.5%; that question is recorded as open in the report.
OUTCOME: completed
